source: BNSS 2023, Section 359 (Gazette of India), via public/bare-acts/bnss.pdf

rows.offence: Enticing or taking away or detaining with criminal intent a married woman.
rows.by: The husband of the woman and the woman.

rows.offence: Voluntarily causing hurt.
rows.by: The person to whom the hurt is caused.

rows.offence: Voluntarily causing hurt on provocation.
rows.by: The person to whom the hurt is caused.

rows.offence: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt on grave and sudden provocation.
rows.by: The person to whom the hurt is caused.

rows.offence: Wrongfully restraining or confining any person.
rows.by: The person restrained or confined.

rows.offence: Wrongfully confining a person for three days or more.
rows.by: The person confined.

rows.offence: Wrongfully confining a person for ten days or more.
rows.by: The person confined.

rows.offence: Wrongfully confining a person in secret.
rows.by: The person confined.

rows.offence: Assault or use of criminal force.
rows.by: The person assaulted or to whom criminal force is used.

rows.offence: Uttering words, etc., with deliberate intent to wound the religious feelings of any person.
rows.by: The person whose religious feelings are intended to be wounded.

rows.offence: Theft.
rows.by: The owner of the property stolen.

rows.offence: Dishonest misappropriation of property.
rows.by: The owner of the property misappropriated.

rows.offence: Criminal breach of trust by a carrier, wharfinger, etc.
rows.by: The owner of the property in respect of which the breach of trust has been committed.

rows.offence: Dishonestly receiving stolen property knowing it to be stolen.
rows.by: The owner of the property stolen.

rows.offence: Assisting in the concealment or disposal of stolen property, knowing it to be stolen.
rows.by: The owner of the property stolen.

rows.offence: Cheating.
rows.by: The person cheated.

rows.offence: Cheating by personation.
rows.by: The person cheated.

rows.offence: Fraudulent removal or concealment of property, etc., to prevent distribution among creditors.
rows.by: The creditors who are affected thereby.

rows.offence: Fraudulently preventing from being made available for his creditors a debt or demand due to the offender.
rows.by: The creditors who are affected thereby.

rows.offence: Fraudulent execution of deed of transfer containing false statement of consideration.
rows.by: The person affected thereby.

rows.offence: Fraudulent removal or concealment of property.
rows.by: The person affected thereby.

rows.offence: Mischief, when the only loss or damage caused is loss or damage to a private person.
rows.by: The person to whom the loss or damage is caused.

rows.offence: Mischief by killing or maiming animal.
rows.by: The owner of the animal.

rows.offence: Mischief by injury to works of irrigation by wrongfully diverting water when the only loss or damage caused is loss or damage to private person.
rows.by: The person to whom the loss or damage is caused.

rows.offence: Criminal trespass.
rows.by: The person in possession of the property trespassed upon.

rows.offence: House-trespass.
rows.by: The person in possession of the property trespassed upon.

rows.offence: House-trespass to commit an offence (other than theft) punishable with imprisonment.
rows.by: The person in possession of the house trespassed upon.

rows.offence: Using a false trade or property mark.
rows.by: The person to whom loss or injury is caused by such use.

rows.offence: Counterfeiting a property mark used by another.
rows.by: The person to whom loss or injury is caused by such use.

rows.offence: Selling goods marked with a counterfeit property mark.
rows.by: The person to whom loss or injury is caused by such use.

rows.offence: Criminal intimidation.
rows.by: The person intimidated.

rows.offence: Insult intended to provoke a breach of peace.
rows.by: The person insulted.

rows.offence: Inducing person to believe himself an object of divine displeasure.
rows.by: The person induced.

rows.offence: Defamation, except such cases as are specified against section 356(2) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, column 1 of the Table under sub-section (2).
rows.by: The person defamed.

rows.offence: Printing or engraving matter, knowing it to be defamatory.
rows.by: The person defamed.

rows.offence: Sale of printed or engraved substance containing defamatory matter, knowing it to contain such matter.
rows.by: The person defamed.

rows.offence: Criminal breach of contract of service.
rows.by: The person with whom the offender has contracted.

rows.offence: Word, gesture or act intended to insult the modesty of a woman.
rows.by: The woman whom it was intended to insult or whose privacy was intruded upon.

rows.offence: Marrying again during the life-time of a husband or wife.
rows.by: The husband or wife of the person so marrying.

rows.offence: Causing miscarriage.
rows.by: The woman to whom miscarriage is caused.

rows.offence: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt.
rows.by: The person to whom hurt is caused.

rows.offence: Causing hurt by doing an act so rashly and negligently as to endanger human life or the personal safety of others.
rows.by: The person to whom hurt is caused.

rows.offence: Causing grievous hurt by doing an act so rashly and negligently as to endanger human life or the personal safety of others.
rows.by: The person to whom hurt is caused.

rows.offence: Assault or criminal force in attempting wrongfully to confine a person.
rows.by: The person assaulted or to whom the force was used.

rows.offence: Theft, by clerk or servant of property in possession of master.
rows.by: The owner of the property stolen.

rows.offence: Criminal breach of trust.
rows.by: The owner of the property in respect of which breach of trust has been committed.

rows.offence: Criminal breach of trust by a clerk or servant.
rows.by: The owner of the property in respect of which the breach of trust has been committed.

rows.offence: Cheating a person whose interest the offender was bound, either by law or by legal contract, to protect.
rows.by: The person cheated.

rows.offence: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property or the making, alteration or destruction of a valuable security.
rows.by: The person cheated.

rows.offence: Defamation against the President or the Vice-President or the Governor of the State or the Administrator of the Union territory or a Minister in respect of his public functions when instituted upon a complaint made by the public prosecutor.
rows.by: The person defamed.
